answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Every claim climbs the ferrous of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vault re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The thread of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
